interpretation: The library keeps healthy clients at target throughput and near-perfect fairness when 10 percent of peers are impaired. Moderate loss remains serviceable. Poor links become variable and disconnect some peers. Severe links preserve healthy service but spend almost the entire affected offered rate on undelivered work while delivering almost nothing, with queue growth to about 22 MB. This is good isolation but incomplete evidence of bounded disruption handling.
